descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 30 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
**Xtadium – Immersive Sports Streaming in VR & MR**

Xtadium puts you inside the action with immersive sports experiences in VR and mixed reality. Step into tunnels, training sessions, and behind-the-scenes moments, or watch from angles you simply can’t get anywhere else.
 
Explore football, combat sports, action sports, and more through real immersive footage. Move between viewpoints, look around freely, and experience the moment as if you’re there.

[media]
 
Powered by YBVR and featured as one of Meta’s top Mixed Reality apps, Xtadium transforms your Meta Quest 2, Quest 3, or Quest Pro into the ultimate sports arena. Now easier to use than ever. Navigate seamlessly between experiences, discover new content automatically, and enjoy support for multiple languages and subtitles across live and on-demand content.
 
Download Xtadium for free and experience sports from the inside.

xtadiumvr.com | @XtadiumVR
